evidence_spans.snippet: Table 19. Register Map
The DEVID register holds a fixed device ID code of 0xE5 (345 octal).
The THRESH_TAP register is eight bits and holds the threshold value for tap interrupts. The scale factor is 62.5 mg/LSB
The OFSX, OFSY, and OFSZ registers are each eight bits and offer user-set offset adjustments in twos complement format with a scale factor of 15.6 mg/LSB
The DUR register is eight bits and contains an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 625 µs/LSB.
The latent register is eight bits and contains an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 1.25 ms/LSB.
The window register is eight bits and contains an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 1.25 ms/LSB.
The THRESH_ACT register is eight bits and holds the threshold value for detecting activity. The scale factor is 62.5 mg/LSB.
The THRESH_INACT register is eight bits and holds the threshold value for detecting inactivity. The scale factor is 62.5 mg/LSB.
The TIME_INACT register is eight bits and contains an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 1 sec/LSB.
The THRESH_FF register is eight bits and holds the threshold value... The scale factor is 62.5 mg/LSB.
The TIME_FF register is eight bits and stores an unsigned time value... The scale factor is 5 ms/LSB.
Table 25. Register 0x2C... LOW_POWER bit (D4)... Rate bits (D3:D0)
Table 26. Register 0x2D... Link, AUTO_SLEEP, Measure, Sleep, Wakeup
Table 28. Register 0x2E... DATA_READY, SINGLE_TAP, DOUBLE_TAP, Activity, Inactivity, FREE_FALL, Watermark, Overrun
Table 30. Register 0x2F... DATA_READY, SINGLE_TAP, DOUBLE_TAP, Activity, Inactivity, FREE_FALL, Watermark, Overrun
Table 32. Register 0x30... DATA_READY, SINGLE_TAP, DOUBLE_TAP, Activity, Inactivity, FREE_FALL, Watermark, Overrun
Table 34. Register 0x31... SELF_TEST, SPI, INT_INVERT, FULL_RES, Justify, Range
These six bytes (Register 0x32 to Register 0x37) are eight bits each and hold the output data for each axis.
Table 36. Register 0x38... FIFO_MODE, Trigger, Samples
Table 39. Register 0x39... FIFO_TRIG, Entries
The maximum SPI clock speed is 5 MHz with 100 pF maximum loading
the timing scheme follows clock polarity (CPOL) = 1 and clock phase (CPHA) = 1

t DELAY: 5 ns min, t QUIET: 5 ns min, t CS,DIS: 150 ns min
there must be at least 5 µs between the end of reading the data registers and the start of a new read of the FIFO
After V S is applied, the device enters standby mode... It is recommended to configure the device in standby mode and then to enable measurement mode.
